text:
Drake Batherson made the month's funniest headline: asked about Sidney Crosby trade talk, he said Crosby could have his house if he comes to Ottawa. On the ice he has been just as busy. He has 12 goals and 22 points in 25 games, a pair of power-play goals lately, and he ranks 20th in the league in wins added by goals.

The goals come with a warning. He has 12 on 8.1 expected, shooting 22% against 20% last season and a league rate near 13.5%. That finishing rarely lasts, even for a good shooter. The rest of his game is solid: the Senators take 55% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on, and All Three Zones tracking (Corey Sznajder's) puts his primary shot assists at the 89th percentile among forwards, so he sets up teammates as much as he finishes. He has 51 hits, too. A fourth-round pick, 121st overall, projecting 60 to 83 points.
